info.description: OpenAPI contract for the public Matjero Storefront API.
info.title: Matjero Storefront API

get.description: Returns the app identity, localization context, authenticated principal when present, and market list.

parameters.description: Page size, capped by the service default
parameters.name: limit

get.description: Reads the active Cart identified by the HttpOnly cart bearer cookie.
get.summary: Read Cart for resolved Store host

post.description: Creates an active Cart bound to the resolved Store host and returns its bearer cookie.
Adds a public SKU and quantity to the active Cart.
post.summary: Add a public SKU to Cart

delete.description: Removes an item from the active Cart.

patch.description: Updates the item quantity in the active Cart.

get.description: Returns the public category tree for the resolved store. Each node carries its parent slug so a client can rebuild the hierarchy.
Resolves a category slug within the store resolved from the request host. A slug belonging to another store returns 404.
get.summary: Get a public category by slug

post.description: Creates a Checkout Session for the active Cart.
Finalizes an eligible Checkout Session and creates an Order.

get.description: Reads a Guest Order authorized by HttpOnly capability cookie.

post.description: Cancels a pending Guest Order authorized by HttpOnly capability cookie.

get.description: Returns a bounded page of publicly listed products for the resolved store. Prices are seller listing prices in the store market currency.

parameters.description: Keyword matched against localized product name, description and slug
parameters.name: q

parameters.description: Minimum price in currency minor units
parameters.name: min_price

parameters.description: Maximum price in currency minor units
parameters.name: max_price

parameters.description: Filter by derived availability: in_stock or out_of_stock
parameters.name: availability

parameters.description: Sort order: newest, price_asc, price_desc or name_asc
parameters.name: sort

get.description: Resolves a product slug within the store resolved from the request host. A slug not publicly listed by this store returns 404.
get.summary: Get a public product by slug

get.description: Keyword search across localized product name, description and slug, scoped to the resolved store. Accepts the same filters, sort and pagination as product browsing.

parameters.description: Keyword matched against localized product name, description and slug
parameters.name: q

parameters.description: Minimum price in currency minor units
parameters.name: min_price

parameters.description: Maximum price in currency minor units
parameters.name: max_price

parameters.description: Filter by derived availability: in_stock or out_of_stock
parameters.name: availability

parameters.description: Sort order: newest, price_asc, price_desc or name_asc
parameters.name: sort

get.description: Returns the public store identity, market, currency, locales, public settings, and published theme configuration for the store resolved from the request host. Accepts optional X-Matjero-Storefront-Preview header for draft preview configuration, which bypasses cache and returns a non-cacheable private response.

parameters.description: Optional signed, short-lived preview token to view draft theme configuration
parameters.name: X-Matjero-Storefront-Preview

tags.name: Storefront
